limits.historical_graph: Bounded documentary dependencies, not a proof of every historical assertion or a minimal logical basis.
limits.node_counts: Named units, proof branches, table data and aliases have different roles and complexities. Raw node-count ratios are not compression measurements.
limits.costs: The original graph has overlapping evidence locators and no additive weights. A separate exclusive full-document partition is required. All retained external proof costs remain null rather than zero; the known source scientific-graphics limitations remain explicit.
limits.formalization: Only the previously reviewed declarations and their stated interfaces are formalized. This graph does not make the full umbrella, complete application proofs or exhaustive census end-to-end Lean theorems.
limits.independence: The reviewer previously authored parts of the accepted Topic A proof library and several source deductions; the current volume and logical graph were authored by other agents. This is an independent reading of the present graph, not independent historical invention.
